reuse.why: Calls the shared getScheduledAmount from shared/schedules, the same function the forecast, schedules app and budget templates use, rather than re-deriving the rule.

placement.why: The field is added in the api/schedules-get handler with a list-only APIScheduleListEntity type, keeping create/update input types untouched; putting it in scheduleModel.toExternal would also have been reasonable.

scope.why: Handler, list type, API docs entry, a test and a release note, all for the requested field.

maintainability.why: Any change to the expected-amount rule in getScheduledAmount reaches the API automatically, and the read-only field is typed separately from inputs.
